title: Pacifo: An Efficient Fully Homomorphic Encryption-based Lightweight ResNet for Trustworthy Machine Learning as a Service
abstract: arXiv:2610.33525v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) has become a popular paradigm for deploying AI applications. However, it raises significant privacy concerns that the raw client data needs to be uploaded to the server for inference services. Private inference using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a solution by allowing computations directly on encrypted data, with only the final results decrypted on a client side. However, current practical implementations still suffer from large computational overhead and high latency due to the cost of FHE operations. In this paper, we propose Pacifo, a framework that adapts customized fine-tuning strategies to efficiently evaluate the ResNet20 model in the context of FHE. Specifically, Pacifo introduces a public-private layer partitioning scheme and an efficient ReLU approximation, significantly reducing the number of private layers and costly FHE operations during inference. tldr: 提出了Pacifo框架，通过公私层划分方案和高效ReLU近似等定制化微调策略，在全同态加密环境下高效评估ResNet20模型，显著降低了隐私推理的计算开销和延迟。
en_tdlr: Pacifo, a framework that adapts customized fine-tuning strategies including public-private layer partitioning and efficient ReLU approximation, enables efficient evaluation of ResNet20 under Fully Homomorphic Encryption, significantly reducing computational overhead and latency in private inference.
